changelog: First public release of fx-admin — modern, themed, optimized admin panel for QBCore, Qbox and ESX.

New Gang Management page: the full Job Management toolset - bulk and per-selection removal, transfer to another gang, grade reset, single and bulk CK with backup and restore, member list with online/offline filter, search and CSV export - now works on gangs too. Jobs and gangs are two separate pages under the Jobs & Gangs nav group.

Jobs and gangs share ONE code path instead of duplicated code. Every layer (framework, database, business logic, UI) takes a kind parameter that is either job or gang, so a later fix lands on both sides at once. Omitting it means job, so nothing that called these functions before had to change.

Gang operations write to players.gang through SetGang using the gang JSON schema (no payment/onduty fields). Counts, personnel queries and the reset/transfer UPDATEs all pick their column from the category, and the count cache is now per category - one shared cache would have let gang counts overwrite job counts.

Discord logs are category-aware. Gang operations can go to their own Config.GangLogsWebhook and fall back to JobLogsWebhook then LogsWebhook. Embed title, field names (Old Gang / New Gang) and footer follow the category, and CK records from this page are tagged gangck so CK History and the restore log label them correctly.

Recent Actions is filtered per category: the job page no longer shows gang operations and vice versa. Entries written before this release carry no category field and are treated as job, so existing history stays intact.

New config keys: Config.JobManagement.GangResetTarget (default "none") is the gang a removed member is moved to, and Config.GangLogsWebhook (empty = falls back to the job webhook). Config.JobManagement.HistoryLimit is shared between job and gang history - raise it if both sides are used heavily.
ESX has no gang concept, so the Gang Management page stays empty there and every gang operation is rejected with a nogang error instead of silently touching the player job.
Fixed: the jobmgmt.hard_grade_desc locale string was cut off mid-sentence in both tr and en, so the final grade-reset confirmation showed half a sentence.
